summary: The Real-Time Analytics Engineer designs and maintains low-latency, streaming data systems for instant insights, monitoring, and analytics.
responsibilities: Build streaming pipelines using Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, or Storm
Implement real-time data ingestion, transformation, and aggregation
Optimize pipelines for latency, throughput, and reliability
Support dashboards, anomaly detection, and AI/ML real-time models
Monitor and troubleshoot production streaming systems

education: 4–7 years of experience in streaming and real-time data engineering

skills_required.name: Expertise in real-time streaming platforms (Kafka, Flink, Kinesis, Storm)
Programming in Python, Java, or Scala
Cloud experience for serverless or real-time processing
